items.quote: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time
items.claim: The angel of the LORD called to Abraham from heaven a second time

items.quote: By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son
items.claim: God swore an oath because Abraham obeyed and did not withhold his son
items.mechanism: thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son

items.quote: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies
items.claim: God promised to bless Abraham, multiply his descendants as numerous as stars and sand, and give them possession of their enemies' gates
items.action: will bless; will multiply; shall possess
items.object: thee; thy seed; the gate of his enemies

items.quote: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice
items.claim: All nations of the earth shall be blessed through Abraham's seed because of his obedience
items.actor: all the nations of the earth
items.mechanism: thy seed; thou hast obeyed my voice
